item.text: I’m building the first version around a transparent baseline model: mean daily log-return drift with volatility-scaled uncertainty bands, plus a rolling holdout backtest. It stays explainable in the UI and avoids presenting a single number as certainty.

The dashboard is now in place with the embedded five-year snapshot, CSV upload path, forecast controls, chart hover tooltips, and rolling validation metrics. I’m moving into browser-level checks now; I’ll fix any runtime or layout issues surfaced there.

const fs=require('fs');const tab=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/sp500-tabs.json','utf8')).find(x=>x.type==='page');const ws=new WebSocket(tab.webSocketDebuggerUrl);let id=0;const pending=new Map();const connected=new Promise(r=>ws.addEventListener('open',r,{once:true}));ws.addEventListener('message',e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id&&pending.has(m.id)){pending.get(m.id)(m);pending.delete(m.id);}});const send=(method,params={})=>new Promise(r=>{const requestId=++id;pending.set(requestId,r);ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:requestId,method,params}));});const ev=async expression=>(await send('Runtime.evaluate',{expression,returnByValue:true,awaitPromise:true})).result.result.value;(async()=>{await connected;await send('Runtime.enable');await send('Page.navigate',{url:'file:///tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5.6-luna-max-Qeiamt/index.html'});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));const result=await ev("'`(async()=>{const rows=Array.from({length:60},(_,i)=>{const d=new Date(Date.UTC(2020,0,2+i));return d.toISOString().slice(0,10)+'"','+(3000+i*4)});const file=new File([['date,value',...rows].join('\\\\n')],'upload.csv',{type:'text/csv'});const dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(file);const input=document.getElementById('csvInput');Object.defineProperty(input,'files',{value:dt.files,configurable:true});input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));return JSON.stringify({status:document.getElementById('dataStatusTitle').textContent,detail:document.getElementById('dataStatusDetail').textContent,latest:document.getElementById('latestValue').textContent,error:document.getElementById('errorBanner').className})})()"'`);console.log(result);ws.close();})();
NODE'
